name: All Points Tree Service
summary: Fully insured tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, lot clearing, planting and root feeding for homes and businesses within approximately 40 miles of San Leon, Texas.

emergency.title: 24/7 emergency service
emergency.text: Storm damage does not wait. Emergency crews respond around the clock across Dickinson, League City, Friendswood, Houston and Galveston County.

hero.title: Expert tree care
hero.lead: Professional residential and commercial tree care backed by approximately 25 years of industry experience. Free estimates and fast response.
hero.imageAlt: All Points Tree Service branded truck and professional tree equipment

groups.title: Tree Trimming & Pruning
groups.summary: Professional trimming by an experienced crew, including tall palms and difficult terrain.
groups.intro: Careful crown shaping, canopy lifting and structural pruning help keep trees healthy, safe and attractive. Few companies in the area will trim 70-foot palms; our climbers do it with bucket trucks and technical rigging.
groups.imageAlt: All Points Tree Service crew trimming tall residential palm trees

services.title: Crown Thinning, Lifting & Reduction
services.text: Structural pruning that opens a canopy, lifts it clear of a roof or drive and brings an overgrown crown back into shape.

services.title: 70-Foot Palm Trimming
services.text: One of our most requested specialties, done safely from bucket trucks and with technical rigging, as on a 70-foot palm job in Friendswood.

services.title: Deadwood & Hazard Branch Removal
services.text: Dead, hanging and split limbs taken out before they come down on a fence, a roof or a driveway.

services.title: Corrective Pruning
services.text: Pruning that corrects poor structure or earlier bad cuts so a tree grows the right way from here on.

groups.title: Dangerous Tree Removal
groups.summary: Storm-damaged, diseased or hazardous trees removed safely with proper rigging.
groups.intro: Our dangerous tree specialty separates us from local competition. We remove storm-damaged, diseased, dead or structurally compromised trees using conventional and technical rigging, safely and efficiently regardless of terrain, proximity to structures or tree size.
groups.imageAlt: All Points Tree Service truck at a residential tree worksite

services.title: Storm Damage Emergency Response
services.text: Fallen and leaning trees cleared around the clock after a storm, across the Houston and Gulf Coast communities.
points: Trees cleared from fences, roofs and access routes

services.title: Diseased & Dead Tree Removal
services.text: Dead, diseased and structurally compromised trees taken down before they fail on their own.

services.title: Technical Rigging & Sectional Dismantling
services.text: A large storm-damaged oak leaning over a residential fence in League City came down in sections on rope rigging, with no property damage.

groups.title: Stump Grinding
groups.summary: Heavy-duty stump grinders remove stumps completely and the yard is left spotless.
groups.intro: We use heavy-duty machines with a toothed disk that spins and tears into your stump swiftly, eliminating it completely below grade. No more tripping hazards, unsightly stumps or unwanted regrowth, and the yard is left clean and ready for replanting or landscaping.
groups.imageAlt: Stump grinding work in progress on a residential lawn

services.title: Below-Grade Stump Removal
services.text: Any size stump, residential or commercial, ground out below grade so it cannot sprout again.
points: Any size stump, residential and commercial

services.title: Multi-Stump Jobs
services.text: After a lot clearing job in Dickinson the homeowner had eleven stumps of various sizes, and every one came out below grade level.

groups.title: Lot Clearing
groups.summary: Full land preparation: removal, mulch clearing, stump grinding and site readying.
groups.intro: Lot clearing requires arborists, heavy machinery and a coordinated workforce. We handle complete site preparation for residential and commercial properties, and the site is left clean and construction-ready.

services.title: Site Preparation
services.text: A two-acre commercial lot in Texas City was cleared for new construction and ready in two days.

services.title: Debris Removal & Hauling
services.text: Cut material chipped or hauled away as part of the job, so nothing is left behind for you to deal with.
points: Full debris removal and hauling included
Chipping service available by the hour

groups.title: Tree Health & Planting
groups.summary: Deep root feeding and planting chosen for Houston-area climate and Gulf Coast soil.
groups.intro: Keeping a tree healthy is cheaper than removing it. We feed established trees below the surface where the root hairs are, and we help select and plant new trees suited to local climate and soil.
groups.imageAlt: Residential property after planting and landscape restoration

services.title: Root Feeding
services.text: Deep root feeding places nutrients below the surface where root hairs can easily absorb essential elements and minerals, which matters in the Texas heat and Gulf Coast climate.
points: Deep root injection below the surface
Applied by experienced tree care professionals

services.title: Planting Service
services.text: Based on local climate and soil conditions, our experienced team helps select trees suited to the Houston area and Gulf Coast soil, then plants them for long-term success.
points: Species selection for local climate and soil

services.title: Arborist Consulting
services.text: An experienced crew looks at what you have, names the visible hazards and recommends the trimming or removal that is actually needed.

promo.title: Prepare your property before the storm.
promo.text: Address dead limbs, weakened trees and branches near structures well before tropical-storm conditions arrive.

about.title: Based in San Leon, working the Gulf Coast since 2007.
text: All Points Tree Service is a family-owned, community-focused company founded in San Leon, Texas in 2007, with an experienced crew ready for challenging tree work and approximately 25 years of industry experience. Work runs from a San Leon base out to properties within roughly 40 miles.

The work covers residential and commercial tree care: trimming and pruning, dangerous tree removal, stump grinding, lot clearing, root feeding and planting, with 24/7 emergency response for storm damage and hazardous trees.
about.imageAlt: All Points Tree Service crew with a branded truck and chipper

facts.heading: Hurricane Preparedness
facts.text: Atlantic hurricane season runs June 1 through November 30, and property work is safest completed well before a storm enters the Gulf. Official evacuation and preparedness resources are gathered in one guide: City of Galveston hurricane evacuation, Houston Office of Emergency Management, TxDOT hurricane preparation and routes, Texas Division of Emergency Management and NOAA hurricane information.

facts.heading: Storm Safety Notice
items: All Points Tree Service is not an emergency-management agency
Conditions, evacuation zones and routes may change
Always follow current instructions from local and state officials
Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies
Keep people away from fallen trees and any nearby power lines
Do not attempt tree work during severe weather, and wait for safe conditions afterwards
